# Checklist: requirements
<!-- Generated by /speckit.checklist -->
<!-- Branch: 005-gamificacao | Date: 2026-09-12 -->

Supersedes the 38-row list auto-generated with the spec. **Run before implementing** — in 004
this pass found nine gaps that would otherwise have arrived as workflow rejections, one launch
each.

Every row is something a reader could answer **wrong**, where answering it wrong changes what
gets built. A row that restates a requirement has been deleted rather than kept for the count.

| ID | Check | Dimension | Ref | Status |
|----|-------|-----------|-----|--------|
| CHK001 | **FR-007 states the cap as a requirement and FR-009 makes it editable data. Which wins?** If an admin sets `regrasXp.nivelMaximo` to 20, is the product broken or retuned? A test asserting "the cap is 10" would then be asserting a **seed value**, not a rule — and would fail on a lab that retuned legitimately | [consistency] | FR-007, FR-009 | [ ] |
| CHK002 | **The credit hook is registered on FIVE collections but only FOUR of them score.** `evento` carries `aprovacaoRegistrada` too, and FR-008 says calendar activity awards no XP in v1. Does T017's wording cause event publication to credit? | [consistency] | FR-006, FR-008 | [ ] |
| CHK003 | Does `xpTotal` keep growing past the cap while `nivel` stops? It must — **FR-013 sorts the ranking by XP total**, and a capped total makes every maker at level 10 tie forever | [consistency] | FR-007, FR-013 | [ ] |
| CHK004 | At the cap, what does `progressInLevel` report? A bar that resets to empty at level 10 reads as a demotion; one that stays full is the decided answer, and nothing says which | [clarity] | FR-007, SC-006 | [ ] |
| CHK005 | Is each of FR-006's five actions reachable by a real trigger in the merged code, named in the spec? Four have one (`stampApproval` × 3, `concluidaEm`); the fifth is created by this feature | [feasibility] | FR-006 | [ ] |
| CHK006 | **FR-011's reconciliation is a TEST, not a runtime repair.** What happens in production when a projection drifts — does any requirement say it is repaired, or only that CI notices? | [completeness] | FR-011, SC-004 | [ ] |
| CHK007 | FR-013 sorts by a stored projection. If it is stale the ranking is silently wrong and nothing looks broken. Is that risk stated anywhere a reader of the ranking will meet it? | [completeness] | FR-013, FR-010 | [ ] |
| CHK008 | **FR-017 assigns a new skill to EVERY maker.** Is "every" bounded? D4's sibling case — the reactivation loop — was priced and moved out of the write transaction; this one was not | [feasibility] | FR-017, D4 | [ ] |
| CHK009 | FR-025 says a publication credits "once per content, across unpublish/republish". Is the *ref* the content's id, and does that survive a slug change or a migration that renumbers? | [testability] | FR-025, FR-003 | [ ] |
| CHK010 | FR-002 requires the entry to record the **skill credited**. Which skill does *publishing a project* credit? A project has a category, not a skill, and no requirement maps one to the other | [completeness] | FR-002, FR-006 | [ ] |
| CHK011 | Same question for an article and a 3D model — is the skill derivable from the content, or does the content need a new field this spec has not asked for? | [completeness] | FR-002, FR-006 | [ ] |
| CHK012 | FR-012's lab level is "a projection of the organization's whole ledger". Summed over makers who have since been **erased** (004's FR-031 deletes profiles) — do their entries survive, and should they count? | [consistency] | FR-012, FR-001 | [ ] |
| CHK013 | FR-001 says append-only. 004's account erasure removes a `perfilMaker`. Does an orphaned ledger entry pointing at a deleted profile break the reconciliation, the ranking, or both? | [consistency] | FR-001, FR-011 | [ ] |
| CHK014 | CLR-005 fixes the scale at 0–10. Is the off-by-one closed in **every** place a level appears — maker, skill, lab, the pip bar, the author strip — or only where SC-006 tests it? | [consistency] | CLR-005, FR-007 | [ ] |
| CHK015 | FR-029 says XP never sums between organizations. Is the **lab level** confined the same way, given it aggregates rather than reads one row? | [testability] | FR-029, FR-012 | [ ] |
| CHK016 | FR-004 grants XP inside the causing transaction. For a **mission**, what is the causing action — the submission, or the approval? FR-022 says approval; is the hook on the collection that actually changes then? | [clarity] | FR-004, FR-022 | [ ] |
| CHK017 | FR-023 allows one open submission per mission. After a **rejection**, may the maker submit again? The unique index on `(missao, maker)` would refuse it, and no requirement says whether it should | [completeness] | FR-023, US3 | [ ] |
| CHK018 | FR-019 hides a deactivated skill from the maker's panel. Does it also disappear from the **ledger view** and from a mission that names it, and what does an existing mission pointing at a deactivated skill do? | [completeness] | FR-019, FR-020 | [ ] |
| CHK019 | SC-019 asks that a credit be reconstructible from the ledger alone. Does FR-002's field list actually contain enough — is `criadoEm` precise enough to order two credits in the same second? | [testability] | SC-019, FR-002 | [ ] |
| CHK020 | FR-034 adds `projeto.autor`. Existing projects have none. Does the ranking, the lab level or the card rendering assume every published project has an author? | [completeness] | FR-034, US10 | [ ] |
